query:
SELECT
                    m.id AS "id!",
                    m.status AS "status!",
                    m.slug,
                    t.id AS "thread_id!"
                FROM mods m
                INNER JOIN team_members tm
                    ON tm.team_id = m.team_id
                    AND tm.user_id = $1
                    AND tm.is_owner = TRUE
                INNER JOIN threads t ON t.mod_id = m.id
